answer_1.quote: This work aims to improve the localisation and semantic control of latent sentence spaces, by delivering a model which can better separate and control syntactic-semantic features (e.g. predicateargument) and their associated lexical semantics content.
tasks: Other:Granular Semantic Sentence Control and Manipulation
answer_1.outputs: Generated sentences with controlled semantic features (e.g., predicate, arguments) via interpolation and traversal in latent space.

answer_2.quote: We calculate the ratio of generated sentences that hold the same role-content as the inputs (henceforth called the invertibility ratio)... Moreover, we quantitatively evaluate the latent space geometry via interpolation smoothness metrics (IS, ), which calculates the ratio between the ideal semantic distance... and the actual semantic distance... using Word Mover's Distance.
